verdict.rationale: Basecamp's official API repo says an OpenAPI spec exists alongside the REST reference, covering authentication, pagination and every endpoint, so a machine-readable spec is a first-party artifact. The evidence does not give a download location, file format or version for the spec, and no hands-on or independent source confirms it can be retrieved, so coverage of the 'download' part is unproven. missing for 10: a documented download URL or file for the OpenAPI spec, the spec's format and version details, independent or hands-on confirmation that the spec can be downloaded and used.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: The OpenAPI spec and this REST API reference cover authentication, pagination, and every endpoint in detail.
